content.note: The plaintext here is a stand-in. The real payload schema (Envelope.Payload) is in set 2.

kemBundle.rules: 32 bytes is a bare X25519 key. 4+32+1184 bytes starting with ascii SKB1 is hybrid. Anything else is skipped.

notes: Bytes are lowercase hex unless the key ends in Base64, which is standard base64 of the exact bytes the app stores.
AES-GCM ciphertexts are CryptoKit combined form: 12 byte nonce, then ciphertext, then 16 byte tag.
Every case was opened again with the Swift code before it was written here.

sponsored.note: prfOutput is what the key returns for prfSalt. Proving a browser gets the same output as the iPhone for the same key and salt needs a real key on both; see section 15.
